correctness.rationale: For omitted original-side counts x,y, forced x*y subdivision vertices imply p+q-1+(x-1)(y-1) for x,y>0, and x=0 or y=0 forces at least p+q. Hence any smaller-size optimizer has exactly one omitted vertex on one side. Unique mandatory subdivider set and the exact distance-two witness conditions give omitted subset size 2 through opposite-part size minus 1. Families are disjoint, independent and counted by binomial profiles. Exceptional C8: four selected necessary, gap quadruples counted 1+12+2, giving 8*(15)/4=30; exactly 2 independent. Independent direct-definition exhaustive checker validates nine small pairs, not the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: A complete structural optimizer census for a natural infinite family links semitotal domination and full edge subdivision, strengthens the known size result to a trivariate exponential-growth count and establishes that every optimum is independent beyond a sharp C8 exception, where 28 of 30 are not. These are natural optimizer-space invariants, not just a small numerical increment.
